reason: Both correctly identify 'U' as no suitable pan detected and reach the right conclusion that the pans are non-magnetic, with no faulty-hob or engineer claims. Conversation 2 was correct but thinner, and its boilerplate panels undermined it: an irrelevant electrical-fault safety panel and a 'check a suitable replacement / enter model number' panel pushing a part lookup when ground truth says no part is needed.
